summary: A Stack with a wrapping Flex row of three chips above a single padded Box.
use: Composing small layouts with spacing props instead of custom CSS.
spec: `<Flex gap="3" align="center" justify="between" wrap>` holds 3 `<Box class="chip" px="3" py="1">` items
Chip labels: Flex, space between; gap 3; wraps
A last `<Box class="chip" p="4">` reads Stack gap 4, Box padding 4
